units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 0
units.source: Please welcome the General Manager to give a speech.
units.translation: Recibamos al gerente general para que pronuncie su discurso.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 1
units.source: Distinguished guests, good evening.
units.translation: Distinguidos invitados, buenas noches.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 2
units.source: First, thank you all for taking time out of your busy schedules to attend tonight's celebration.
units.translation: En primer lugar, gracias a todos por sacar tiempo de sus ocupadas agendas para asistir a la celebración de esta noche.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 3
units.source: Tonight we gather together to celebrate the company's full ten years.
units.translation: Esta noche nos reunimos para celebrar los diez años de la empresa.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 4
units.source: These ten years wouldn't have been possible without the effort of everyone present.
units.translation: Estos diez años no habrían sido posibles sin el esfuerzo de todos los presentes.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 5
units.source: I'd also like to sincerely thank our partners for their support along the way.
units.translation: También quisiera agradecer sinceramente a nuestros socios por su apoyo durante todo este camino.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 6
units.source: Next, please allow me to share a few reflections.
units.translation: A continuación, permítanme compartir algunas reflexiones.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 7
units.source: Please applaud as the General Manager continues speaking.
units.translation: Aplaudamos mientras el gerente general continúa su discurso.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 8
units.source: Thank you all for the applause.
units.translation: Gracias a todos por sus aplausos.

units.context: Scenario: Formal Speech and Toast at an Event · Lesson: Opening a Formal Speech · dialogue line 9
units.source: Let's continue moving forward hand in hand.
units.translation: Sigamos avanzando juntos de la mano.
